articles.title: Govt stands firmly behind HYDRAA: Revanth Reddy
articles.description: Hyderabad, July 28 (IANS) Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy said on Tuesday that the state government stands firmly behind the Hyderabad Disaster Response and Asset Protection Agency (HYDRAA). A day after the Telangana High Court directed the Chief Secretary to immediately replace HYDRAA Commissioner A.V. Ranganath for repeatedly flouting court orders, the Chief Minister told reporters in New Delhi that he had not yet examined the court order in detail. Stating that the government will review the order, Revanth Reddy made it clear that the government has the highest respect for the judiciary. He termed HYDRAA as the greatest reform by his government and stated that the agency will be strengthened further. Revanth Reddy alleged that some people were making false propaganda against HYDRAA. He said encroachers had filed false cases against the agency and produced fake documents to mislead the court. He made it clear that HYDRAA will continue its duty to remove encroachments on water bodies and government lands. On Monday, the High Court asked Chief Secretary Sanjay Jaju to identify a suitable officer to replace Ranganath as the head of HYDRAA. The direction was given in a contempt case relating to a 40-acre parcel of land at Lothkunta involving a private construction company. The single-judge bench noted that as many as 63 contempt cases were reportedly pending against the HYDRAA Commissioner during his one-and-a-half-year tenure. A private construction company had filed the contempt case relating to the land at Lothkunta, accusing HYDRAA officials of entering the property and fencing it despite subsisting judicial restraint orders. The High Court had ordered Ranganath to tender an apology through a written affidavit by Monday. Ranganath, an Indian Police Service (IPS) official, has been heading HYDRAA since the agency was formed two years ago by the state government. During the last two years, HYDRAA claims to have saved 3,315 acres of government land worth Rs 1.5 lakh crore and restored several water bodies. The agency said it reclaimed and protected lakes, nalas, parks, government lands, and blue-green resources. Following the court order, Ranganath listed the works undertaken by HYDRAA during the last two years. He remarked that contempt petitions were filed against him by land grabbers. --IANS ms/dan

articles.title: National SC-ST Hub Scheme Drives Technology Upgradation For MSMEs
articles.description: The National SC-ST Hub Scheme (NSSH) scheme, under the Ministry of MSME, continues to strengthen the competitiveness of SC-ST entrepreneurs by enabling technology upgradation, enhancing business capabilities and facilitating greater participation in public procurement. Through interventions such as the Special Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme (SCLCSS) and the Business Acceleration Programme (BAP), the scheme is helping enterprises overcome operational constraints, adopt modern technologies, augment compliance and access larger institutional markets. Engineering Excellence through Technology Upgradation: The Journey of Varun Enterprises, Punjab Led by Mr. Hukum Chand, Varun Enterprises has established a strong presence in the engineering and manufacturing sector by delivering reliable, high-quality industrial solutions. With focus on precision, quality and compliance, the enterprise steadily built its capabilities to meet the requirements of institutional and Government buyers. Overcoming Capacity Constraints As the enterprise expands, adopting advanced technology became essential to enhance productivity, reduce turnaround time and remain competitive in an evolving market. Hence, with support from the National SC-ST Hub Office, Ludhiana, Varun Enterprises availed ₹15.67 lakh under the SCLCSS during 2021-22. This support enabled the installation of advanced manufacturing equipment, including a fibre laser cutting system, CNC hydraulic press brake, air compressor, UPS systems and supporting electrical infrastructure. The upgraded machines significantly enhanced production efficiency, precision, quality and operational reliability, enabling the enterprise to participate in larger procurement. A significant milestone was securing a ₹95.99 lakh purchase order from the Modern Coach Factory (MCF), Rae Bareli, for supply of connection boxes in rail coaches. This achievement reinforced the enterprise's credibility as a reliable supplier capable of delivering quality engineering solutions for the railways. Positioning for Long-Term Growth With modern manufacturing capabilities, Varun Enterprises has positioned its footprint in high-value engineering products. The support received under SCLCSS has enabled the enterprise to pursue new opportunities in Government and institutional markets while laying a strong foundation for sustained growth. Scaling Excellence in Petroleum Logistics through Strategic Capability Enhancement: The Journey of Raju Thangavelu, Tamilnadu Based in Tiruvallur, Mr. Raju Thangavelu has built a dependable enterprise in the petroleum logistics sector, specializing in the transportation of bulk fuels. By consistently adhering to stringent safety compliance and operational standards, the enterprise has established itself as a trusted service provider with a growing presence in Government procurement. Overcoming Growth and Compliance Challenges As demand for its services increased, the enterprise faced the challenge of expanding fleet capacity while meeting the stringent safety and regulatory requirements of oil marketing companies. To address these challenges, the enterprise availed ₹25 lakh under SCLCSS . The assistance upgraded transportation infrastructure and safety-compliant systems, strengthening fleet capacity, improving operational efficiency and enhancing service reliability, thereby, enabling the enterprise to meet evolving industry standards while improving its competitiveness. Expanding Presence in Public Procurement. The SCLCS support enabled the enterprise to secure large assignments in the public procurement ecosystem. A key milestone was the award of a transportation contract from Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL) in April 2026, reflecting the enterprise's growing credibility and ability to execute large-scale transportation assignments in logistic sector. Transforming Healthcare Manufacturing through Integrated Business Support: The Journey of BOI (B. Ortho International Pvt. Ltd.), Jharkhand Led by Mr. Rahul & Mrs. Divya from Ranchi, BOI (B. Ortho International Pvt. Ltd. ) has established itself in the medical and orthopedic manufacturing sector by delivering quality products that meet stringent healthcare standards. With a strong focus on precision, compliance and reliability, the enterprise has steadily built its reputation in institutional and public sector markets. Unlocking the Next Stage of Growth As demand for their products increased, the need to upgrade machinery, improve operational efficiency and business capabilities became essential. Hence, with support from the National SC-ST Hub, Ranchi, the enterprise received assistance from both SCLCS and the Business Acceleration Programme (BAP). The SCLCS supported in installation of advanced machinery and production infrastructure, while BAP provided strategic mentorship, business guidance and market linkages. BOI significantly enhanced its production capacity and now manufactures approximately 50,000 pairs of latex surgical gloves per day. Improved manufacturing efficiency and quality standards helped double the enterprise's turnover from ₹15 lakh to ₹30 lakh, while its operations also generated local employment with around 60% women workforce participation, contributing to the regional economy. A Common Story of Inclusive Enterprise Development The success stories of Varun Enterprises (Punjab), Raju Thangavelu (Tamil Nadu), and BOI (B Ortho International Pvt. Ltd., Jharkhand) demonstrate how targeted support can transform enterprises into resilient and competitive businesses. By enhancing their capabilities, operational efficiency and participating in the public procurement process, it has enabled the SC-ST enterprises to contribute to the nation's inclusive economic growth. These examples illustrate how the National SC-ST Hub Scheme is fostering inclusive entrepreneurship. The scheme is helping in reliable supply chains, increased employment generation and participation of SC/ST entrepreneurs in India's industrial ecosystem. Moving Forward As India continues to strengthen its manufacturing capabilities, the National SC-ST Hub scheme remains committed to empowering SC/ST entrepreneurs through technology upgradation, capacity building, business acceleration and market linkages. The success stories of Varun Enterprises, Raju Thangavelu, and BOI stand as an examples of how integrated policy support can transform entrepreneurial potential into long-term business success, contributing to the vision of an Atmanirbhar Bharat .

articles.title: OPINION | India has built the grant stack for deep tech. The procurement stack must evolve
articles.description: Public procurement commands over a fifth of India's GDP, yet its rules were written to buy commodities. India can rapidly scale indigenous deep tech innovation with simple amendments to the General Financial Rules
